description: `directives set` (cli.py's cmd_directives) refuses unconditionally outside a real interactive terminal (directives.py's module docstring: this is Mike's own act, from Mike's own ordinary shell, never a pane's or a harness's). A subprocess launched by this conformance harness never has a tty on stdin/stdout, so this refusal is fully deterministic and needs no special setup — no project config, no `--yes`, nothing bypasses the tty check. Distinct from `InsidePaneError` (HERDR_PANE_ID set), which is not exercised here.

expect.stderr: directives set requires an interactive terminal; run it from your own terminal
